proof_body:
by
  intro P Q a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ h₁ h₂ hP hQ
  have hdP := hP.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hdQ := hQ.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have cP := hP.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero
  have cQ := hQ.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero
  have hc : Continuous (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => fderiv ℝ Q z (1, 0) + (-fderiv ℝ P z) (0, 1)) :=
    (cQ.clm_apply continuous_const).add (cP.neg.clm_apply continuous_const)
  have key := MeasureTheory.integral_divergence_prod_Icc_of_hasFDerivAt_of_le Q (fun z => -P z)
    (fderiv ℝ Q) (fun z => -fderiv ℝ P z) (a₁, a₂) (b₁, b₂) (Prod.mk_le_mk.2 ⟨h₁, h₂⟩)
    hQ.continuous.continuousOn hP.continuous.neg.continuousOn
    (fun x _ => (hdQ x).hasFDerivAt) (fun x _ => (hdP x).hasFDerivAt.neg)
    (hc.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc)
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, intervalIntegral.integral_neg] at key
  rw [Set.Icc_prod_Icc]
  have e : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => fderiv ℝ Q z (1, 0) - fderiv ℝ P z (0, 1)) =
      fun z : ℝ × ℝ => fderiv ℝ Q z (1, 0) + -fderiv ℝ P z (0, 1) := by
    funext z
    ring
  rw [e, key]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (P Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ), a₁ ≤ b₁ → a₂ ≤ b₂ → ContDiff ℝ 1 P → ContDiff ℝ 1 Q → (∫ z in Set.Icc a₁ b₁ ×ˢ Set.Icc a₂ b₂, (fderiv ℝ Q z (1, 0) - fderiv ℝ P z (0, 1))) = (∫ x in a₁..b₁, P (x, a₂)) + (∫ y in a₂..b₂, Q (b₁, y)) - (∫ x in a₁..b₁, P (x, b₂)) - ∫ y in a₂..b₂, Q (a₁, y)
